notes: ICAO identifiers, official aerodrome names and ARP coordinates are taken from aviation AIP/authority publication where available. IATA codes are cross-check identifiers linked to the pinned public OurAirports dataset and should be treated as secondary evidence unless separately confirmed by the airport operator.

Addis Ababa is the sole coordinate with only archival mirrored-AIP evidence; ECAA AIS portal is provided as the current primary verification route. Keep the archival status visible until current ECAA coordinates are confirmed.
All selected points are airport reference points, not terminals, entrances, boundaries, or city centres. Airport points do not imply any scheduled route or playable airport grounds.
